satellites.title: Light in the Work of Life
satellites.evidence: The modern word 光合作用 names photosynthesis, a biological process involving light. Its physical meaning is distinct from the religious language of 無量光.

satellites.title: Soften the Light, Join the Dust
satellites.evidence: Daodejing 4 and 56: 挫其銳，解其紛，和其光，同其塵 — “blunt the sharpness, untie the tangles, soften the glare, be one with the dust.” Light here is something to temper, not to maximize; the later idiom 和光同塵 comes from these lines.
